transcript: Generator interlock and inlet box for Arthur Pendelton at 73 Crestview Drive. Mounted a thirty-amp generator inlet box on the exterior wall. Ran fifteen feet of ten three Romex over to the main electrical panel. Installed a mechanical interlock kit on the Square D panel, and one 30-amp two-pole breaker. Wait, make that twenty feet of wire because we had to route around the gas meter. Labor was two and three quarter hours.

expected.job_summary: Generator 30A inlet box and panel interlock kit installation
expected.notes: Routed wire around exterior gas meter.
